FOU now selects GRE (default), IPIP, or SIT as its encapsulated tunnel type, deriving the receive IP protocol and matching native device instead of hardcoding IPIP. The console, CLI, previews, address-family validation, and runtime ownership use the same selection. Review and saved details show the tunnel type and both UDP ports separately.

Update both endpoint agents before using FOU; these plans require command protocol 7. The CLI uses `--fou-tunnel-kind gre|ipip|sit`; numeric `ipproto` inputs are no longer accepted. No database migration is required for deployments without existing FOU plans; existing legacy FOU declarations are not automatically converted. OpenVPN behavior is unchanged.
